Congrats! You slept 7 nights in Ferrytown without spending enough days sleeping outside it, so you are now a shifter. When replacing your race with shifter, you lose all racial features from your original race, apart from any flying, swimming, or climbing speed and all but one of any proficiencies granted by your race. To clarify, a player will lose one racial proficiency of their choice (if their race had no proficiencies this has no effect) and all non-proficiency, non-flying, swimming, or climbing speed features from their original race. They will replace their original ability score improvements with those from their shifter subrace, and gain all appropriate shifter features apart from languages and proficiencies. Which shifter subrace a player is will be up to DMD/mariam depending on their animal, though most will be given a choice between two options. Use this space to talk with any other players who have become shifters or ask DMs questions about how this works. The process is irreversible.
